name: AL-06
label: Safe R

key_factors: Strong Republican district with a PVI of R+17
Incumbent Gary Palmer running with a large fundraising edge
Prediction markets price Republican win at 96%
model.rationale: Palmer holds a heavily Republican Birmingham-area seat, has a roughly 160-to-1 cash advantage, and faces a Democratic challenger with almost no resources or outside support. Markets and district fundamentals both point to an easy Republican hold.
model.watch: A late influx of outside spending for the Democrat or an unexpected incumbent scandal would be the only plausible path to narrowing the race.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Gary Palmer is seeking another term in this solidly Republican Birmingham-area district, where the partisan lean favors Republicans by about seventeen points. He enters the general election with more than $1 million raised and a large cash advantage, while Democrat Maurice Mercer has raised under $7,000 and reports minimal cash on hand.

No public polls or expert ratings cover the race, so the outlook rests on district fundamentals, fundraising, and prediction markets, which give the Democrat only a small chance. Palmer is a heavy favorite to hold the seat, with the main uncertainty being turnout patterns rather than the competitive balance of the race itself.
